sources.excerpt: May 8, 2026 - ... Generative AI has already made a huge impact on how

reasoning: The claim misinterprets and oversimplifies findings from a widely cited March 2023 Goldman Sachs report. The report estimated that generative AI could expose the equivalent of 300 million full-time jobs globally to automation, not that 300 million workers will definitively lose their jobs or be completely replaced. The authors emphasized that for most occupations, AI would serve as a complement to human labor rather than a full substitution, automating a portion of tasks while creating new roles and boosting overall productivity. Framing this projection as a certainty that AI "will replace 300 million jobs" conflates automation exposure with outright job destruction.
